declarations.value:
--theme(
    --default-font-family,
    -apple-system,
    BlinkMacSystemFont,
    'Segoe UI',
    Roboto,
    'Helvetica Neue',
    'Noto Sans',
    Arial,
    sans-serif,
    'Apple Color Emoji',
    'Segoe UI Emoji',
    'Segoe UI Symbol',
    'Noto Color Emoji'
  )
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace
clamp(var(--radius) - 1000 * var(--radius-step, 0px), var(--radius-field, var(--radius)), var(--radius) + 1000 * var(--radius-step, 0px))
color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, translate, opacity
